company.name: Bundle
company.shortDescription: Bundle gives consumers unique chances to interact with well-known and beloved businesses and win money that could change their lives.
company.description:
Bundle is the first networked rewards platform in the world, revolutionizing how companies interact with and reward their clients.

Bundle provides companies with access to significantly more incentives than they could provide on their own by pooling brand incentive funds into common reward pools. Even though they only contribute a small portion of the total incentive value, brands can increase conversions.

productsAndServices.description: A blockchain-powered platform that pools brand incentive budgets into shared rewards funds for customer acquisition and loyalty campaigns.
productsAndServices.name: Bundle Shared Rewards Platform
